video_title: Glen Big Baby Davis Gets REAL About Prison Time, Guarding Shaq, & Kevin Garnett Giving Him $$$

quotes.speaker: Glen Big Baby Davis
quotes.summary_phrase: Glen Big Baby Davis on his competitive relationship with Kevin Garnett
quotes.excerpt: I kind of bumped heads with everybody a little bit, because they got to kind of feel you out.
quotes.quote: I kind of bumped heads with everybody a little bit, because they got to kind of feel you out to see if you are a real one. I low-key, you got to stand your ground, and I did that with Kevin Garnett my first day, and I think that is how we became really good friends.

quotes.speaker: Glen Big Baby Davis
quotes.summary_phrase: Glen Big Baby Davis on the challenge of guarding LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: I hated guarding him. He was so good. He is really my GOAT.
quotes.quote: I hated guarding him. He was so good. He is really my GOAT.

quotes.speaker: Glen Big Baby Davis
quotes.summary_phrase: Glen Big Baby Davis on his ability to guard Shaquille O'Neal
quotes.excerpt: I can guard Shaq. A lot of people back in the day they couldn't guard Shaq.
quotes.quote: I can guard Shaq. A lot of people back in the day they couldn't guard Shaq because, you know, I am like a football player playing basketball.

quotes.speaker: Glen Big Baby Davis
quotes.summary_phrase: Glen Big Baby Davis on guarding Dwight Howard
quotes.excerpt: I could guard him too. He just was energy and he couldn't score.
quotes.quote: I could guard him too. He just was energy and he couldn't score. I didn't have to worry about Dwight Howard scoring. So, I just let him do his thing.

quotes.speaker: Glen Big Baby Davis
quotes.summary_phrase: Glen Big Baby Davis on Victor Wembanyama's potential
quotes.excerpt: He is a young kid, got a big upside. He gives me baby giraffe type of vibes.
quotes.quote: Right now, I just think he is a young kid, got a big upside. He gives me baby giraffe type of vibes. He is so tall and just awkward moving sometimes because he is 7'4, 7'5.

quotes.speaker: Glen Big Baby Davis
quotes.summary_phrase: Glen Big Baby Davis on the talent of drawing fouls
quotes.excerpt: Being able to draw fouls is a talent. You got to be able to know how to fake.
quotes.quote: I would put him in my top 10 because being able to draw fouls is a talent. You got to be able to know how to fake and do stuff like that, so that is special.

quotes.speaker: Glen Big Baby Davis
quotes.summary_phrase: Glen Big Baby Davis on the importance of financial literacy for athletes
quotes.excerpt: You can't let other people do things for you and expect them to say you know what I fucked up.
quotes.quote: In my situation, you got to be more attentive, right? You can't let other people do things for you and expect them to say you know what I fucked up. With my fraud case, it was the fact that the collective bargaining agreement and the player basically, that is a deal between the owners and the players. And in that deal, the owners gives us an opportunity to get healthcare, but we have to be able to put the money into the account, right? So, I put my own money in my account, right? And so now they match it. And so now during my years as a player, it eventually grows.

quotes.speaker: Glen Big Baby Davis
quotes.summary_phrase: Glen Big Baby Davis on maintaining discipline as an athlete
quotes.excerpt: It is discipline. It is the discipline to be able to say no.
quotes.quote: It is discipline. It is the discipline to be able to say no. But then also, it is also people, places, and things, right? Because other people can entice you to do things, right? You are your right-hand man, hey man, I need you to miss a couple rebounds today. I need you to go under. You got people like that around you, and you are not disciplined yourself, you are going to creep over there, especially in tough times.

quotes.speaker: Glen Davis
quotes.summary_phrase: Glen Davis on being prepared for life's opportunities
quotes.excerpt: Don't be sleep when opportunity is knocking at the door.

text_blocks.speaker: Glen Davis
text_blocks.text: My motivational speech is don't be sleep when opportunity is knocking at the door. Be prepared. If you know what you want and you know what you're trying to achieve, put the work in. Put the work in because there's going to be an opportunity and it might come when you least expect it. Be ready when you start knocking at the door. That's my advice because I think we go out there all the time and we forget what we're doing and lose focus. Don't lose focus on your dreams and goals and be ready when your time has come.

text_blocks.speaker: Punky
text_blocks.text: Do not be sleep when an opportunity may be leading your way, because opportunities come and you might be sleep. So you want to be woke so you won't miss that opportunity.
